app.name: Userplane
app.short_description: Request screen recordings from Zendesk tickets
app.long_description: Userplane lets you request and view screen recordings directly from Zendesk Support. Create recording links from ticket sidebars or the top bar, and share them with customers to capture screen recordings.

apiToken.label: API Token
apiToken.helpText: The API token from your Userplane workspace integration settings.

workspaceId.label: Workspace ID
workspaceId.helpText: Your Userplane workspace ID. Found in your workspace integration settings.
